description: Job side parity: add optional Rules + optional Demo Asset + multi-select platforms to the Post Job form, and persist them into the campaigns row tagged payout_model='job' via jobs_provider createJob/updateJob. Reuses the DemoAssetField widget from FEAT-001. Depends on FEAT-001 (shared widget + SQL columns).
steps: In lib/features/admin/screens/post_job_screen.dart: add a _rulesCtrl TextEditingController, state List<String> _selectedPlatforms (default ['Instagram']), DemoAssetType _demoAssetType = DemoAssetType.none, String? _demoAssetValue. Reuse the same _platforms list values used on the campaign form (Instagram, Facebook, YouTube) - define a local const list in this file.

In initState of post_job_screen.dart, prefill from widget.existingJob map (job map is a SELECT * campaigns row passed through _mapCampaignToJob, so raw columns are present): _rulesCtrl.text = j['rules'] ?? ''; split j['platform'] comma string into _selectedPlatforms; map j['demo_asset_type'] -> DemoAssetType and _demoAssetValue = j['demo_asset_url'].

In post_job_screen.dart build(): add a 'Platforms' multi-select chips section (toggles over the platform list, dark-mode-safe using existing isDark/textPrimary style helpers and _SectionLabel), a 'Rules (Optional)' PremiumTextField.multiline bound to _rulesCtrl, and a 'Demo Asset (Optional)' section using the DemoAssetField widget wired via onChanged to setState.

In _save() of post_job_screen.dart, add to the `data` map passed to createJob/updateJob: 'platform': _selectedPlatforms.join(','); 'rules': trimmed rules or null; 'demo_asset_type': mapped enum->string or null; 'demo_asset_url': _demoAssetValue or null. (Keep existing keys unchanged.)

In lib/features/jobs/providers/jobs_provider.dart createJob(): add these keys to the .from('campaigns').insert({...}) map as plain insert VALUES (this is SAFE - they are values, not query filters, exactly like the existing payout_model:'job' value): 'platform': data['platform'], 'rules': data['rules'], 'demo_asset_type': data['demo_asset_type'], 'demo_asset_url': data['demo_asset_url']. Add an explanatory comment noting these are write-values and must never be used in a .eq/.neq filter or named in a .select projection.

In jobs_provider.dart updateJob(): add guarded pass-through like the existing pattern - if (data.containsKey('platform')) update['platform'] = data['platform']; and the same for 'rules', 'demo_asset_type', 'demo_asset_url'.

Confirm (by reading) that _mapCampaignToJob does `...row` spread so rules/demo_asset_type/demo_asset_url/platform survive to jobDetailProvider without being named anywhere - add a one-line comment there noting these columns pass through via the spread. Do NOT add them to any .select().
acceptance_criteria: post_job_screen.dart has optional Rules multiline, optional Demo Asset (via DemoAssetField), and multi-select platform chips; prefills them on edit; passes platform (comma-joined) + rules + demo_asset_type + demo_asset_url into the createJob/updateJob data map.
jobs_provider.dart createJob inserts platform/rules/demo_asset_type/demo_asset_url as VALUES into the campaigns insert; updateJob passes them through with the existing containsKey guard pattern.
No server-side .eq/.neq/.filter on payout_model or on any of the new columns is introduced; none of the new columns are named inside a .select(...) projection.
All changed .dart files have balanced braces and parentheses.
verification: grep jobs_provider.dart for the new keys and confirm they appear only inside insert({...})/update maps, never inside .select(...) or .eq(...)/.neq(...).
grep for "payout_model" in lib/ and confirm still no server-side filter on it.
Read _mapCampaignToJob and confirm the `...row` spread carries the new columns through.
Balance-check braces/parens in post_job_screen.dart and jobs_provider.dart.
findings: Implemented in lib/features/admin/screens/post_job_screen.dart and lib/features/jobs/providers/jobs_provider.dart. post_job_screen: added _rulesCtrl (disposed), _selectedPlatforms=['Instagram'] with a local static const _platforms=[Instagram,Facebook,YouTube] matching the campaign form, _demoAssetType/_demoAssetValue state; initState prefills rules, splits j['platform'] comma string into chips (matched case-insensitively against _platforms), and maps j['demo_asset_type']->DemoAssetType + j['demo_asset_url']. Added a 'Platforms' multi-select ChoiceChip section (dark-mode-safe via isDark/textPrimary and AppColors surface/border tokens, keeps at least one selected), a 'Rules (Optional)' PremiumTextField.multiline, and a 'Demo Asset (Optional)' DemoAssetField (storageFolder 'job-demo-assets') reused from FEAT-001. _save() adds platform (comma-joined), rules (null when empty), demo_asset_type (mapped enum->key or null), demo_asset_url (or null) to the data map; existing keys unchanged. jobs_provider: createJob inserts platform/rules/demo_asset_type/demo_asset_url as plain VALUES (with explanatory comment); updateJob adds containsKey-guarded pass-throughs for all four; added a comment on _mapCampaignToJob noting the `...row` spread carries the columns through. VERIFICATION (static only; Flutter SDK not installed, INTEGRATIONS_ONLY): grep confirms no new column is named in any .select(...) projection and no server-side .eq/.neq/.filter on payout_model exists (only a comment referencing why it is avoided). All .select() on campaigns are arg-less SELECT *. Brace/bracket balance OK in both files; the pre-existing ( vs ) count imbalance in jobs_provider comes from string/comment literals in the untouched HEAD version (328 vs 333 at HEAD) - my additions are perfectly balanced (14 open/14 close). No em dashes in added content. Only the two lib files were modified; admin_app and Rexo-store- stale copies untouched. Detail-screen rendering (rules/demo asset/platform pills, gated by isNotEmpty) is FEAT-003 scope, not FEAT-002. Note: post_job_screen still contains a pre-existing TODO(remove-debug) block surfacing raw insert errors - left as-is, out of scope.
